entries.title: Psalms 86:1
segments: <<A Prayer of David>> Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.

entries.title: Psalms 86:2
segments: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 86:3
segments: Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 86:4
segments: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 86:5
segments: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.

entries.title: Psalms 86:6
segments: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 86:7
segments: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.

entries.title: Psalms 86:8
segments: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.

entries.title: Psalms 86:9
segments: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:10
segments: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.

entries.title: Psalms 86:11
segments: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 86:12
segments: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify thy name for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 86:13
segments: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

entries.title: Psalms 86:14
segments: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.

entries.title: Psalms 86:15
segments: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.

entries.title: Psalms 86:16
segments: Oh turn unto me, and  have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.

entries.title: Psalms 86:17
segments: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me.
